label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Following tracks is always on, with no switch: a tap within a finger's width (22 dp, 10-150 m) of a track is reached from the route's last point along the tracks and ends on the track beside the tap (point to point), not branching off to the tap. The last point (a hut, say) joins the track straight if within 200 m. Any other tap is a straight line, as before, with no message.
Taps are added in order; if the map's tracks are not to hand within 3 s (no connection), the tap is drawn straight.
The drawing bar is a small note under the status message ('Drawing route · Done'; tap it to finish).
A missing-source message (no connection) shows once, for 4 s, and not again until the phone's connection comes back.

tests.kotlinJvm: all pass (new: ends on the track, exact join points, one piece, reach)
